value.behaviour: Tests the redirect and the notice in the old frontend system, through the real legacy page and layout.
rules: Render `CatalogEntityPage` on a `/catalog/:namespace/:kind/:name/*` route with `EntityLayout` as its child, and a small probe that prints the current location and offers a real Back through `useNavigate`.
Use `catalogApiMock.mock` for lookups, so call counts and deferred promises can be asserted.

Import the plain component from `./CatalogEntityPage`, not the routable extension in `plugin.ts`, whose `createRoutableExtension` wrapper throws its own mount-point error on an unbound ref before the page renders.
For the unbound scenario pass `mountedRoutes` with only `/catalog` bound to `rootRouteRef`, which `EntityLayout` needs, and nothing bound to `entityRouteRef`.

tests.name: shows the not-found page when the entity route cannot be resolved
tests.given: an exact miss and a former lookup that would hit, first with `entityRouteRef` unbound and route entries `/catalog/default/component/other` then `/catalog/default/component/old`, then with `entityRouteRef` mounted at `/t/:tenant/:namespace/:kind/:name/*` from `/t/acme/default/component/old`, where the route function throws on the missing `tenant`
tests.expect: unbound: `Warning: Entity not found` renders with no thrown error, the location stays, `getEntityByFormerRef` is never called, and after Back the panel renders again for `other` with no hook-order error. Throwing route function: `getEntityByFormerRef` is called and the same panel renders with no error alert

value.behaviour: Tests the redirect and the notice in the new frontend system, through the alpha page and both of its layouts.
rules: The BUI layout is the one chosen with no `headers` matching; the alpha MUI layout is chosen by passing a `headers` entry whose element matches and no `headerLayouts`.
Use `catalogApiMock({ entities })` with an entity declaring the former ref, so the in-memory lookup runs end to end.

For the unbound case omit `mountedRoutes` and keep `mountPath` and `initialRouteEntries`, so the route params still come from the URL while `entityRouteRef` has no path. With no entity the page always takes the BUI layout.
